title: What a Familiar Spirit Is
text: A familiar spirit is a demonic spirit guide — a counterfeit of the Holy Spirit — sent by the enemy to guide your steps into wrong places, wrong people and wrong decisions. Familiar means well known. A familiar spirit is a demonic spirit guide with long-standing, intimate knowledge of you and your bloodline. A familiar spirit is a supernatural being that is said to assist witches, sorcerers, wizards and others in their practice of magic and divination. They are known as familiars, familiar animals or spirit guides. They are the spirits that direct you wrongly — to the wrong people, wrong churches, wrong friends, wrong everything in your life. They know your ancestors. They know your grandparents. They know your great-grandparents. They know your family lineage and everyone in it, the ones who have passed and the ones still alive. The Latin word behind familiar spirit is familiaris — household servant. He serves the household, and what he serves the household with is destruction and iniquity. When a person willingly or ignorantly forms a relationship with an evil spirit, he or she has a familiar spirit. Anyone who becomes a channel of communication for an evil spirit has a familiar spirit. Having a familiar spirit is to personally identify with a demon spirit — like a demon guardian. When you understand what the familiar spirits are, it is a spirit guide. It is a demonic spirit that the enemy sends to guide your steps and lead you into wrong ways and wrong things — wrong churches and wrong people, wrong marriages and wrong things in your life. Familiar means well known. So these are spirits that know you well. These are spirits that know your secrets. Familiar spirits know you better than you know yourself. Familiar spirit knows when you were conceived and what was said when you were conceived. A familiar spirit is a bad spirit that follows a person around and whispers wrong directions. God gives His children the Holy Spirit instead. The Holy Spirit is the only Guide we need. Think of a familiar spirit as a fake GPS. It knows your name, your family, your habits and your secrets — and it deliberately gives you the wrong route: wrong friends, wrong relationship, wrong church, wrong choices. The Holy Spirit is the real Guide, and He never misdirects you. Pastor Kiky defines the familiar spirit first by its function and then by its name. Functionally it is a spirit guide — a demonic escort assigned to direct a person's steps. Etymologically, familiar means well known: this spirit has long-term, intimate knowledge of a person and a bloodline. That combination — intimate knowledge plus directive influence — is what makes it so effective at deception. Scripture consistently pairs familiar spirits with divination, necromancy and mediumship (Deuteronomy 18:9-12; Leviticus 19:31; Leviticus 20:27; Isaiah 8:19; Isaiah 29:4). The Hebrew term rendered familiar spirit (’ôb) is used both of the spirit and of the medium who hosts it, which is why Leviticus 20:27 speaks of a man or woman that hath a familiar spirit. The biblical category is therefore not neutral spiritual sensitivity but an unlawful channel of information — a counterfeit of the prophetic ministry of the Holy Spirit, who alone brings all things to remembrance (John 14:26). Deuteronomy 18:9-12 Isaiah 8:19 Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank You for revelation, because Your word says my people perish for lack of knowledge. Every demonic spirit guide assigned to direct my steps, I renounce you now in the name of Jesus. Holy Spirit, take position and possession over my life, my home and my destiny in the mighty name of Jesus. I do not need any other spirit — I need the Holy Spirit. I rebuke that familiar spirit in the name of Jesus. The Holy Spirit is my Guide, and He orders my steps. Where in your life have you accepted direction you never questioned — a friendship, a relationship, a church, a business decision? Bring each one before the Lord and ask Him who was guiding it. Name the two things that make a familiar spirit dangerous — what it knows, and what it does with what it knows.

title: What God Says About Familiar Spirits
text: God has forbidden consultation with familiar spirits and declared them an abomination. He is not neutral about them — He hates them, and He does not want His people troubled by them. God calls consultation with familiar spirits an abomination. He is not neutral — He hates the spirit and He wants His people free of it. Deuteronomy 18 lists the consulter with familiar spirits alongside the diviner, the observer of times, the enchanter, the witch, the charmer, the wizard and the necromancer — and calls all of it an abomination unto the Lord. Isaiah 8:19 exposes the absurdity of the practice: why should a people that has God go seeking to spirits that peep and mutter? Should the living seek to the dead? Isaiah 29:4 describes the voice of one that has a familiar spirit — a whisper out of the dust, low and out of the ground. It is a downgraded, grovelling counterfeit of the voice of God. Leviticus 20:27 puts a death sentence on the practice. The severity is the point: this is not a minor irregularity. It is a channel God intends to be completely cut off. There is a terrible group of spirits that are wicked to the core. They can be wicked, friendly or unstable as the situation demands, and many people are ignorant about them. There is no human being who at one time or another has not had an ambush with these spirits. God has bound consultation with familiar spirits. God has told us that familiar spirits are not our friends. It is not on every offence the Bible describes a death sentence. But once the Bible describes a death sentence, it means that it is the only way to stop them. God hates familiar spirits. God is against that spirit and He does not want His people, His saints, to get involved in familiar spirits. God wants His people to be glorious and victorious at all times. God says do not go to people who talk to spirits. He does not say it to be hard on us. He says it because those spirits hurt us, and He wants us safe. God does not ban things to spoil your fun — He bans what will cost you your life. He put familiar spirits in the same list as witchcraft and calls the whole list an abomination, because every one of them plugs your life into a power source that wants you dead. The prohibition is repeated across the Law and the Prophets, which tells us it was a persistent temptation for God's people and remains one. Pastor Kiky draws attention to the weight of the penalty in Leviticus 20:27 as evidence of the seriousness of the channel, and to Isaiah 8:19 as the pastoral argument: a people who have God have no business consulting the dead. Deuteronomy 18 is structured as a contrast: verses 9-14 forbid the divinatory arts of the nations, and verses 15-22 promise a Prophet whom God will raise up and in whose mouth God will put His words. Israel was not left without a voice — it was given a lawful one. The New Testament fulfilment of that lawful voice is Christ, and by the Spirit the church now has the Comforter who teaches all things (John 14:26). Every act of consulting a familiar spirit is therefore a rejection of a provision God has already made. Deuteronomy 18:9-12 Leviticus 19:31 Leviticus 20:27 Isaiah 8:19 Isaiah 29:4 Father, forgive me for every place where I sought answers outside of You, knowingly or ignorantly, in the name of Jesus. Wash me with the blood of Jesus from every defilement that came through mediums, divination or ungodly counsel. Lord, I choose Your voice. Speak to me by Your Spirit and by Your word in the name of Jesus. I will not seek unto the dead — my God is a living God. Every unlawful channel in my life is closed by the blood of Jesus. I am a seeker of God alone. Is there any practice, object, book, app or habit in your life that God's word places on the forbidden list? Name it, renounce it, and remove it this week. Why does Pastor Kiky point to the death sentence in Leviticus 20:27 when teaching on familiar spirits?

title: How Familiar Spirits Operate
text: Familiar spirits work by information. They monitor, gather and file — then they use what they collected to manipulate, misdirect and destroy. They are the power behind mediums and false prophets. Familiar spirits fight with information. They are spy networks and secretary spirits, not sovereign powers — and they are the voice behind mediums and false prophets. Familiar spirits counterfeit the works of the Holy Spirit and they defile the vessel. They are the key enemy spirits in our battle against deception, because they are experts at counterfeiting situations and the move of the Spirit. They collect details: personal talents, neighbours, habits, routines, resources, friends, enemies, materials, mental abilities, weaknesses, tendencies, educational abilities — so that they know the person inside out. They then maneuver and manipulate the victim, transferring the files they have gathered to their agents. Contact with the dead is false. Hebrews 9:27 settles it: it is appointed unto men once to die, and after that the judgment. So what mediums invoke and speak with are familiar spirits — spirits familiar with the dead person and with your lineage. Always seeing the dead is evidence that a person is being troubled by familiar spirits. And when you leave a medium, you do not leave alone — you leave with those spirits, and even more of them. They are the medium spirits behind false prophets. Many prophecies from false prophets are from familiar spirits. They are behind the signs and wonders of false prophets. They monitor through what they plant: that bird that follows you, that cockroach, that mouse, monitoring beds, creaks in the wall, creaks on the steps, spiders, lizards, insects, bees, flies. They also monitor through people they send into your life, and they follow what you post and announce. Familiar spirits are secretary spirits, keeping track of our mistakes, our blunders, in order to trap us in our patterns of sin. They operate as spiritual phone lines to give information about you and I. They are in charge of passing down evil traits, genetic diseases, evil inheritances in our life, in our destinies. One of their traits is to set a spy network with which they gather information to use for attacking your life. The people they are calling to you is not your grandfather. It is not your mother that died. It is a familiar spirit that knows your family. That is why they know the underwear you are wearing — because they were with you in the morning when you were dressing. Familiar spirits are like spies. They watch, they listen, they write things down, and then they use what they know to hurt you. When someone claims to talk to a dead relative, they are really talking to a spy spirit that knew that relative. They run surveillance. They build a file on you — habits, weaknesses, passwords to your behaviour — and then feed that file to whoever is working against you. It is why a false prophet can tell you something private and still be operating by the wrong power. Accurate information is not proof of God. Pastor Kiky's central insight is that the power of these spirits is informational, not sovereign. They cannot read the mind of God, and she notes that some do not even know your plans until you announce them. What they have is accumulated intelligence and access. Remove the access and the intelligence goes stale — which is why the deliverance later in the service targets networks, communication systems, transportation systems and monitoring devices specifically. The account in 1 Samuel 28 shows the medium of Endor operating by an ’ôb — a familiar spirit — and Scripture records God's judgement on Saul for enquiring of it (1 Chronicles 10:13). Ecclesiastes 9:5 states that the dead know not anything, and Hebrews 9:27 fixes a single death followed by judgement, which together rule out ongoing communication with the departed. The conclusion is therefore not that mediums are always frauds, but something more serious: the voice is real, and it is demonic. Hebrews 9:27 Ecclesiastes 9:5 Job 28:7 Every spy network monitoring my life, be dismantled by the fire of God in the name of Jesus. Every communication system of familiar spirits, be destroyed right now in the name of Jesus. Every file, every record, every information gathered against me, be roasted by the fire of the Lord. Blood of Jesus, destroy every familiar spirit manipulation and oppression against me. Let their monitoring systems be destroyed. Let no false prophet see anything about me, in the mighty name of Jesus. I withdraw my life and my blessings from every familiar spirit. Take an honest inventory of what you announce and to whom. This week, practise finishing something before you publicise it. How does a familiar spirit gain its power over a person's decisions — and what does that tell you about how to cut it off?

title: Doors of Entry
text: Familiar spirits do not arrive without a door. Inheritance, mediums, ungodly material, wrong hands laid on you, trauma, wrong friendships and careless announcements are the doors named in this teaching. Every familiar spirit came through a door. Name the door, renounce it, and let the blood of Jesus shut it. Inheritance and foundation. The door was opened by an ancestor, and the spirit rules and destroys the family from that opening. Familiar spirits visit the sins of the fathers upon the offspring, propagate inherited sickness and disease, and cause evil negative family patterns — you see the son do it, the grandson do it, the uncle do it, the mother do it. Mediums and consultation. Visits to magicians, sorcerers, diviners, witch doctors and mediums transfer familiar spirits, and you leave with more spirits than you came with. Ungodly material. Demonic books and occult literature open a door, because words are spirit and they are alive. Be careful what you watch and what you read into your mind and your system. Wrong hands and wrong altars. Deposits can be given through food, through a word, or through hands laid on you by someone carrying a familiar spirit. Pastor Kiky warns specifically about preachers and prophets who carry these spirits and attach more demons to those who draw close. Seeking good things in the wrong place. When good things are sought in a forbidden way, the evil one takes advantage of it — she gives the example of seeking the fruit of the womb in the wrong place. Trauma and violation. The teaching identifies molestation in childhood as a door through which a spiritual marriage of familiar spirits entered and afterwards damaged education, concentration, relationships and destiny. Wrong friendships and wrong company. Some who present as friends are monitoring spirits and evil eyes, planted to watch and to stop. Careless announcing. Some familiar spirits do not know your plan until you say it out loud. Build the house and let the finished house announce itself. Build the business and let the business announce itself. You can acquire familiar spirit by inheritance. An individual can actually have more than one familiar spirit. Visitation to magicians, sorcerers, divinators, witch doctors, mediums will make you acquire familiar spirits. Reading ungodly literature makes one acquire familiar spirits. Words are spirit and they are alive. It is not just friends that come as familiars — but be careful of the preacher. Be careful of the prophets you get close to. Because if they hold familiar spirits, they attach more demons to stop your progress. There are some familiar spirits that would not know what you are about to do until they hear you say it out. A spirit needs an open door. Doors can be opened by family history, by going to people who talk to spirits, by bad books and videos, by hurtful things done to us, and by the wrong friends. When Jesus shuts the door, the spirit cannot come back in. Nothing walks into a locked house. This module is the list of unlocked doors: your family line, occult content, the wrong mentor laying hands on you, trauma someone else caused you, friends who are really informants, and posting your plans before they are finished. Some of those doors you opened. Some were opened on you. Jesus can shut all of them. Pastor Kiky distinguishes carefully between doors a person opened by choice, doors opened by ignorance, and doors opened by someone else's sin against them — particularly childhood violation. That distinction matters pastorally: the response to the first is repentance, to the second is knowledge, and to the third is healing and deliverance without shame. In every case the remedy is the same authority — the blood of Jesus and the finger of God. Scripture shows both inherited and acquired access. Deuteronomy 18 addresses acquired practice; Exodus 20:5 and the visiting of iniquity upon the third and fourth generation address inherited pattern. The New Testament answer is not fatalism but new creation: “if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away” (2 Corinthians 5:17) — the verse the closing prayer of this very service stood on. Christ becoming a curse for us (Galatians 3:13) is the legal ground on which an inherited door is shut. Leviticus 19:31 Isaiah 8:19 Father, in the name of Jesus, every door I opened knowingly or ignorantly, I renounce it and I shut it with the blood of Jesus. Every door opened over my life by my father's house and my mother's house, be shut right now in the name of Jesus. Every door opened by what was done to me, Lord, heal me and shut that door by the blood of Jesus. Every deposit given to me through food, through a word, or through hands laid on me, come out now in the name of Jesus. I am shutting every door to the enemy in my life and in my destiny. Whatever was following me, its hold over me and my family is broken. Every legal right the enemy claimed over me is cancelled by the blood of Jesus. Choose the one door you know is still open. Write it down, renounce it out loud, and shut it with the blood of Jesus in prayer today. List four doors of entry from this module, and say what must happen at each one.

title: The Damage They Cause
text: Familiar spirits cause delay, poverty patterns, destroyed marriages, wrong choices, strange sicknesses, mental torment and premature death. Naming the damage is how you begin to fight it. The damage shows up as a pattern, not a single event. Where a pattern repeats through a bloodline, take it to God as warfare, not as bad luck. Delay. They create illness, confusion and obstruction so that marriages, elevation and purpose are prolonged and postponed. Poverty cycles. They propagate a cycle of poverty: in this family nobody builds a house, nobody crosses this barrier, nobody becomes a millionaire, nobody has a successful business. Marriage destruction. They fight marriages, prevent marriages, engineer marriage to the wrong person where there is already a pattern of divorce, and cause confusion between partners until a person comes out worn out. Wrong choices. They order your steps into distraction — always the same kind of wrong partner, the same kind of wrong friend, the same kind of wrong group. They place scales on the eyes so a person is not seeing, choosing or thinking properly. Wrong churches. They lead people to wrong churches, where sin fills the place and the minister is false, so that even worship is aborted and the person is driven away from Christians and churches completely. Mental torment. They cause mental issues in families — tormenting the mind and the soul, speaking to a person daily, redirecting their steps, controlling thoughts and mindsets. Sickness and death. Strange sicknesses, inherited disease, negative confession, suicidal thoughts, disfavour, and attempts to abort a life before it even receives breath. Spiritual marriage. Invisible rings, night visitations, rejection of spouses and partners, and the fighting of relationships — in both married and unmarried people. They torment our lives. They destroy our lives. They hinder our blessings. They cause our ways to slip. They bring premature death. Familiar spirits are the reason why you cannot sleep at night. Familiar spirit will torment your every move, torment your children, torment your marriages. They are in charge of delays, so they create things for you to be delayed in life. They don't want your life, they want your death. You see your life going sideways, but you don't know why your life is going that way. These spirits steal. They slow good things down, they break up families, they make people sick, and they push wrong choices. Jesus came to give life — the enemy comes to take it. Look for patterns, not just problems. One bad relationship is life. The same bad relationship five times is a pattern — and patterns have a source. This module gives you the list so you can stop blaming yourself for a fight you did not know you were in. Pastor Kiky's diagnostic method is pattern recognition across a bloodline: repeated divorce, repeated business collapse, repeated strange illness, repeated near-misses at the point of breakthrough. She insists the damage is not random misfortune and not merely psychological, while also urging deliverance for the mind and a sound mind as part of the outcome. Hosea 4:6 — “My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge” — is the hinge of this module. Ignorance is itself part of the damage, because a believer cannot resist what they cannot name. This is why Scripture describes the believer's warfare in terms of knowledge and discernment (2 Corinthians 2:11; Ephesians 6:11-12), and why the promise of John 10:10 is set directly against the thief's threefold work of stealing, killing and destroying. Hosea 4:6 John 10:10 Every pattern of poverty, sickness and anti-marriage in my family line, I separate myself from you now in the name of Jesus. Every delay engineered against my life, be destroyed by the fire of God. I remove every scale from my eyes — I will see properly, I will choose properly, I will think properly in the name of Jesus. Every torment on my mind, loose me and let me go, and give me a sound mind in the mighty name of Jesus. My toiling is over in the name of Jesus. I will not be lost, I will not get stuck, I will not be stranded. I will not miss my direction anymore. I will find my path again. I will not run another person's race. Write down one repeating pattern in your family line. Beside it, write the promise of God that contradicts it. Pray that promise daily this week. Name four fields of damage from this module and the counter-promise you will stand on for each.

title: Why Women Are Especially Targeted
text: Satan fights the woman because of what the woman carries. Revelation 12 shows the dragon pursuing the woman who carried the Saviour — and the same hatred continues. The intensity of the attack is a measure of the assignment. Satan pursues the woman because of what the woman carries. Revelation 12 records the dragon persecuting the woman, casting out a flood after her, and the earth helping the woman — and then making war with the remnant of her seed. Pastor Kiky asks the diagnostic question: why the woman? Because the woman carried the Saviour. Satan's agenda against women, as she names it, is to make them prostitute, destitute, useless, possessed, obsessed and oppressed, and to kill them off as quickly as possible. The woman is the womb of man and is called the weaker vessel; she carries virtue, she influences the cradle, the womb and the home. That influence is exactly why she is targeted. Because of this, women are warned specifically about friendships. Some presenting as friends are monitoring spirits and evil eyes sent to watch and to stop. The instruction is not fear but warfare: you either fight, or you perish. Women are urged to pray hard and continually concerning these spirits. Since the devil hates sisters and women very much, they need to pray very hard concerning these spirits. Satan knows that women control the cradle. Satan knows that women control the womb. Satan knows the power of women. Why was that dragon after that woman? The woman carried a Saviour. Woman, be careful of the friends you take. Because some of them are not friends, they are monitoring spirits, monitoring eyes, evil eyes. The devil fought the woman in the Bible because she was carrying Jesus. He still fights women because of what God has put in their hands — children, homes and the future. God protects the woman. In Revelation 12 the dragon does not chase the throne, he chases the woman. Why? Because of what she carries. If the enemy is targeting you, it is not because you are weak — it is because of what is inside you that he cannot afford to be born. This module is pastoral rather than polemical. Pastor Kiky treats the intensity of the attack as evidence of assignment, not of inferiority: the woman is pursued because of what she carries and the influence she exercises over the next generation. The application she draws is discernment in friendship and persistence in prayer. Revelation 12 belongs to a biblical pattern of the seed being attacked: the serpent and the woman's seed (Genesis 3:15), the Hebrew male children (Exodus 1), the children of Bethlehem (Matthew 2). Each assault targets the vessel through which the promise comes. Note also that in Revelation 12 God Himself provides the protection — the earth helps the woman, the wilderness place is prepared for her, and she is nourished there. The believer's confidence rests on God's provision, not on the absence of attack. Revelation 12:13-17 Father, in the name of Jesus, cover me and cover the seed You have placed in my hands. Every monitoring eye and evil eye watching my life through friendship, be blinded in the name of Jesus. Lord, prepare my place and nourish me there, as You did for the woman in Revelation 12. Every agenda of Satan against my womb, my home and my children, be destroyed by the fire of God. The earth is helping me — the flood sent after me is swallowed up. What I carry will be born in the name of Jesus. No lion will overcome me, no bear will overcome me. Review your closest friendships this week. Ask the Lord for discernment about who is genuinely for you, and cover your children and your home in prayer daily. State the pursuit and the provision in Revelation 12, and what each one means for you.

title: The Holy Spirit — The Only Spirit Guide You Need
text: God has already given His people a Guide. The Holy Spirit teaches, reminds, comforts, leads, intercedes and delivers — so no believer needs a familiar spirit. Deliverance is an exchange. Evict the counterfeit guide and give the Holy Spirit position and possession. John 14:26 names the office: the Comforter, the Holy Ghost, whom the Father sends in the name of Jesus, teaches all things and brings all things to remembrance. Acts 2:38 names the order: repent, be baptised in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and receive the gift of the Holy Ghost. Repentance first; then the indwelling Guide. The Holy Spirit's work in this service was practical, not abstract: He fights other presences, He comforts homes and children, He orders steps, He opens doors, He heals, He gives utterance, He baptises with fire. 1 John 4:4 supplies the settled confidence — greater is He that is in you than he that is in the world. The believer is not matching strength with the familiar spirit; a greater Person indwells them. 1 Corinthians 2:12 draws the contrast exactly: we have received the Spirit which is of God — not the spirit of the world — that we might know the things freely given to us of God. Therefore the exchange the whole service calls for is this: renounce the counterfeit guide, and invite the true One to take position and possession. The Holy Spirit is a spirit guide that God gives you as a Christian. The Holy Spirit is meant to bring remembrance of the word of God, to comfort you, to lead you, to intercede for you. We cannot be delivered without the Holy Spirit. It is the touch of the Holy Spirit, it is the fight of the Holy Spirit, to deliver us from any other entity. You need no other entity. You need no other spirit. You don't need that familiar spirit; we rebuke it in the name of Jesus. The Holy Spirit will teach us all things. We don't need to consult any familiar spirit. God does not leave His children without help. He gives us the Holy Spirit. He teaches us, He reminds us of God's word, He comforts us, and He keeps us safe. We do not need any other spirit. You were never offered a choice between guidance and no guidance. The choice is between a guide who wants you dead and a Guide who died for you. One is a counterfeit; the other is the Comforter the Father sends in Jesus' name. Pastor Kiky frames the entire teaching as a substitution rather than a subtraction. Deliverance is not merely the eviction of a false guide; it is the installation of the true one. That is why the service invited the Holy Spirit before the teaching, prayed in the Spirit before the warfare, and closed with seven breathings of the Holy Spirit rather than only with casting out. John 14-16 gives the fullest description of the Spirit's ministry: He abides for ever (14:16), teaches and reminds (14:26), testifies of Christ (15:26), convicts the world (16:8), and guides into all truth while showing things to come (16:13). Every one of those functions has a demonic counterfeit — a false comforter, a false memory, a false witness, false conviction, false guidance, false foreknowledge. This is precisely Pastor Kiky's point that familiar spirits counterfeit the works of the Holy Spirit. The test is never the accuracy of information but the source, the fruit, and agreement with the written word. John 14:26 Acts 2:38 1 John 4:4 1 Corinthians 2:12 John 14:6 Holy Spirit, come and take position and possession of my life, my home and my destiny in the name of Jesus. Baptise me with fire. Let Your fire envelop every area of my life. Holy Spirit, incubate my eyes, my ears and my mouth tonight. Teach me all things and bring all things to my remembrance in the mighty name of Jesus. I do not need any other spirit — I have the Holy Spirit. Greater is He that is in me than he that is in the world. The Holy Spirit orders my steps and I will not be misdirected. Begin each morning this week by consciously inviting the Holy Spirit to take position and possession of your day before you make any decision. Name five works of the Holy Spirit from this module, and the counterfeit each one answers.

title: God Reveals In Order To Redeem
text: A familiar spirit reveals in order for the evil to happen. God reveals so that you can pray and it does not happen. Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and the sentence was reversed. Test the purpose of every revelation. A familiar spirit reveals so it will happen; God reveals so you will pray and it will not. Some false prophets only ever see death — the accident, the day you will die, the hospital rush. They never see prosperity and never see the glory of the Lord. That one-directional sight is a mark of the spirit behind them. Hezekiah is the test case. The word came that he would die. He turned his face to the wall and prayed, and God sent the prophet back with fifteen added years. The revelation was real; the outcome was reversible. So when God shows a hard thing, He is showing you the mindset of the enemy so that the church can gather in faith and pray it down — not announcing an unchangeable fate. The familiar spirit's revelation has the opposite purpose: it is spoken in order to be fulfilled, and it aims at death. Hosea 4:6 explains why revelation matters at all: people perish for lack of knowledge. What you do not know, you cannot resist. What God reveals, you can pray about. Job 28:7 is used to describe a place in God beyond the sight of the birds of prey — “there is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen.” Get closer to God, and there is a place where defeat is not possible. The same God — He reveals to redeem, in the mighty name of Jesus. When a wicked revelation comes, God is revealing it to you for you to pray, so that it doesn't happen like that. The familiar spirit wants to reveal things in your life for it to happen, because that is what they want. They don't want your life, they want your death. As soon as you turn your face against the wall, God terminates the appointments of the wicked in your life. He says, with lack of knowledge my people perish. God sometimes shows us hard things. He is not telling us it must happen. He is telling us to pray so it does not happen. Hezekiah prayed and God gave him fifteen more years. Two voices can tell you the same bad news for opposite reasons. One tells you so it will land. The other tells you so you can stop it. Test the voice by its purpose: God reveals to redeem. This module gives the congregation a discernment tool that is practical and immediate: examine the purpose of a revelation. Does it drive you to prayer and to God, or does it drive you to fear, dependence on a man, and fatalism? Pastor Kiky's use of Hezekiah establishes that a divine warning is an invitation to intercede, and her warning about one-directional prophets of death gives the negative test. Compare Jonah's preaching to Nineveh (Jonah 3:4-10), where an unconditional-sounding word was answered by repentance and the judgement was not executed, with Amos 7:1-6, where the prophet's intercession stopped a declared judgement. Scripture therefore records a category of prophetic word that is announced precisely so that it may be averted. Hezekiah's case (2 Kings 20:1-6; Isaiah 38) is the clearest instance: the same prophet who delivered the sentence returned with the reprieve after prayer. 2 Kings 20:1-6 Hosea 4:6 Job 28:7 Father, every appointment of the wicked over my life, terminate it now in the name of Jesus. Every prophecy of death spoken over me by a wrong voice, I reject it and I cancel it by the blood of Jesus. Lord, whatever You have revealed to me, teach me to pray it through until Your purpose stands. Hide me in the place no bird of prey can see, in the name of Jesus. God reveals to redeem — I will not die, I will live. I reject every negative prophecy spoken over my life. There is a place in God where defeat is not possible, and I am running into it. Take the most frightening thing you have been told about your future. Write it down, then write the prayer you will pray over it daily until it is answered. How do you test whether a revelation came from God or from a familiar spirit?

title: How To Come Out — The Deliverance
text: Surrender, repent, renounce, break every covenant and soul tie, apply the blood of Jesus, cast the spirit out, divorce every spiritual marriage, and breathe in the Holy Spirit. Deliverance follows an order: surrender, repent, renounce, break, apply the blood, uproot, cast out, divorce, fill with the Holy Spirit, seal. 1. Surrender totally. Hand over the marriage, the home, the children, the court case, the torment — vengeance belongs to God (Psalm 94:1), and what you hand to Him He resolves. 2. Repent from every known sin. Without forgiveness there is no deliverance. 1 John 1:8-10 was read for this purpose at the start of the service. 3. Renounce the spirit by name. Renounce every familiar spirit that masquerades as family members, friends, coworkers, neighbours and familiar faces. 4. Break every covenant and soul tie. Every covenant between you and any familiar spirit, every soul tie made knowingly and unknowingly, is broken by the power in the blood of Jesus. 5. Apply the blood. 1 John 5:7-8 — the Spirit, the water and the blood agree in one. Revelation 12:11 — they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. When they see the blood, they pass over. 6. Uproot every planting. Matthew 15:13 — every plant which the heavenly Father has not planted shall be rooted up. Every deposit, mark, remote control, cage and habitation is destroyed and commanded out. 7. Cast out and resist. By air or liquid, through every opening of the body — cough it out, yawn it out, vomit it out. James 4:7 — resist the devil and he will flee from you. 8. Divorce every spiritual marriage. Anoint the ring finger, remove every invisible ring, and divorce the familiar spirit in the name of Jesus. 9. Breathe in the Holy Spirit — seven times. Breathe in the Holy Spirit, hold it, and as you breathe out let every deposit, tomb, habitation, network and communication system of familiar spirits come out. 10. Seal it. Whatever has left is sealed out; the door is closed; the deliverance is covered with the blood of Jesus. You need to surrender your life to Jesus totally. Totality! You need to repent from every known sin. You need to renounce every familiar spirit. You need to go for deliverance when that spirit is manipulating your life. You need by the finger of God to cast out these evil spirits. You need to barricade your life with the blood of Jesus — barricade your life from any future attacks of the familiar spirit. We rebuke every familiar spirit — when they see the blood, they will pass over. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you. Give your whole life to Jesus. Say sorry for sin. Tell the bad spirit to go in Jesus' name. Use the blood of Jesus. Breathe in the Holy Spirit and let the bad thing out. Then let Jesus lock the door. This is the practical part, in order: surrender, repent, renounce, break the contract, apply the blood, uproot the planting, cast it out, divorce the spirit-marriage, breathe in the Holy Spirit, seal the door. Do not skip steps and do not stop halfway. The order matters. Pastor Kiky never begins with confrontation; she begins with surrender and repentance, because legal ground must be removed before authority is exercised. Renunciation revokes consent, the breaking of covenants and soul ties dissolves agreement, the blood provides the legal covering, casting out enforces the eviction, and the seven breathings fill the vacated space with the Holy Spirit so nothing returns. The pattern reflects Matthew 12:43-45, where the evicted spirit returns to an empty house and brings seven others. Deliverance that only evacuates and never fills is unfinished, which is why this service ends with inhaling the Holy Spirit, with salvation, and with sealing. Compare also 2 Corinthians 10:4-5 (strongholds and thoughts), Ephesians 4:22-24 (put off, be renewed, put on), and Colossians 2:14-15 (the handwriting of ordinances blotted out — the legal basis for revoking a covenant). James 4:7 Matthew 15:13 1 John 5:7-8 Revelation 12:11 2 Samuel 22:18 Psalm 144:1-2 Ezekiel 25:17 2 Chronicles 33:6 Father, in the name of Jesus, I surrender everything — my soul, my mind, my heart, my body, my home, my children, my life. By the blood of Jesus I break every soul tie made with familiar spirits, knowingly and unknowingly. Every plant which my heavenly Father has not planted in my life, be rooted up now in the name of Jesus. Every deposit of familiar spirits in my body, by air or by liquid, through every opening of my body, come out now in the name of Jesus. Holy Spirit, fill every place that has been vacated, and seal my deliverance with the blood of Jesus. I renounce every familiar spirit that masquerades as family members, friends, coworkers, neighbours and other familiar faces that I see on a regular basis. I break every soul tie made with familiar spirits, knowingly and unknowingly, by the power in the blood of Jesus. I silence, I destroy and I blind every familiar spirit — you will not see or hear me in the name of Jesus. You demon have no legal rights over my life and destiny through the blood of Jesus. I walk out free with angelic assistance right now, and no one can stop me. Work the ten steps in order this week, writing one line under each. Do not stop at casting out — finish with filling and sealing. List the ten steps out, in order, and say why the last two cannot be skipped.

title: After Deliverance — Doors Are Being Shut
text: Every visitation of the Lord shuts a door the enemy opened. Do not quit because you cannot see the one you were focused on — keep going, and let salvation and the word secure what deliverance opened. Do not quit. Every visitation of the Lord shuts another door — and salvation, the word and a renewed mind keep them shut. Deliverance is progressive as well as decisive. If there are a hundred doors, they are shut one by one — including doors you did not know were open, doors that were causing sickness and infirmity. So the temptation after a deliverance session is to measure everything by the one issue you came for. The instruction is to keep going, because other doors were shut while you prayed. Salvation is the anchor. Romans 10:9 was read and the salvation prayer was prayed, because it makes no sense to be delivered and leave unsaved — it is Christ who gives the strength to resist these spirits, and He comes with His Holy Spirit. 2 Corinthians 5:17 secures the new standing: old things are passed away — old familiar spirits, old practices, old generational practices, old cultural practices — and they are not to be picked up again. Ephesians 3:16-19 was prayed over the congregation: strengthened with might by His Spirit in the inner man, Christ dwelling in the heart by faith, rooted and grounded in love, filled with all the fullness of God. 1 Peter 2:9 and Romans 8:15 close the identity question: a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, called out of darkness into marvellous light, having received not the spirit of bondage again to fear but the Spirit of adoption whereby we cry, Abba, Father. The service sealed every deliverance — whatever has left will not return, that door is completely closed — and dismissed the congregation with the grace and with peace. As you are praying and as you are being delivered, you are shutting up doors in your life. So don't quit. Whilst you feel like deliverance hasn't happened in the place that you are concentrating on, remember there are other doors that have been shut whilst you did that deliverance. Every visitation of the Lord, He shuts up a door that the enemy has opened to destroy your life. And in the end, He will give you your rest when all doors have been shut. We have deliverance, but our true thing is salvation. Most of the time after deliverance people just fall asleep. When that demon is gone, it just gives you a peace. God shuts doors one at a time. Even when you cannot see the change you wanted, other doors were closed. Keep praying. And the most important thing is to belong to Jesus — that is what keeps you safe. Deliverance is not one dramatic moment and done. Picture a house with a hundred unlocked doors. Every time you pray, God locks more of them — including ones you never knew were open. So do not quit at door seven because the door you cared about is number sixty. Pastor Kiky's closing pastoral counsel protects people from two errors: quitting because the presenting issue has not visibly changed, and treating deliverance as a substitute for salvation and discipleship. The remedy for both is the same — remain in the process, be established in Christ, and let the word renew the mind so the old pattern is never picked up again. The New Testament pattern is deliverance followed by discipleship: the Gerasene man delivered and then commissioned to tell his household (Mark 5:19-20), the believers at Ephesus burning their curious books after coming to faith (Acts 19:18-20). Romans 12:2 makes the renewing of the mind the mechanism of lasting change, and Ephesians 4:22-24 gives the sequence — put off the old, be renewed in the spirit of the mind, put on the new. Sealing in prayer and renewal in the word work together; neither replaces the other. Romans 10:9 2 Corinthians 5:17 Ephesians 3:16-19 1 Peter 2:9 Romans 8:15 John 8:36 Romans 12:2 Father, I seal my deliverance with the blood of Jesus — whatever has left me will never return, in the name of Jesus. Lord Jesus, I confess You as my Lord. I believe God raised You from the dead. Be Lord over my life. Strengthen me with might by Your Spirit in the inner man, and let Christ dwell in my heart by faith. Renew my mind, O Lord, so I never pick up the old pattern again. I am a new creature — old things are passed away. I am a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation. I have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear, but the Spirit of adoption. Whom the Son sets free is free indeed — I am free. Write your seven-day aftercare plan today: what you will read, when you will pray, where you will fellowship, and what you will remove from your home. What two things does this module say keep a deliverance from being lost?

title: Repentance
text: Without the forgiveness of the Lord there will be no deliverance, so the service began here — every sin that blocked a testimony, an elevation, a grace or a favour confessed and washed away by the blood. Father, if we say that we have no sin we deceive ourselves; I confess my sins to You now, and I thank You that You are faithful and just to forgive me and to cleanse me from all unrighteousness, in the name of Jesus. Lord, forgive me of every sin that has blocked my testimony, my elevation, my grace and my favour, in the name of Jesus. Forgive me, O Lord, of every transgression, and remove from me every iniquity, in the name of Jesus. Lord, cleanse me with Your blood from my head to my toe, in the name of Jesus. Father, forgive every sin that gave the enemy power to destroy and to keep troubling my life, in the name of Jesus. Lord, renew a right spirit within me and renew a right presence within me, in the name of Jesus. Father, help me to turn away from every wicked way tonight, in the name of Jesus. Every addiction of sin that has become a torment in my life, be destroyed by the blood of Jesus. Lord, do not let the consequences of sin overwhelm my life and my destiny, in the name of Jesus. Sins of my fathers and sins of my mothers, be washed away by the blood of Jesus. Father, give me a new page, give me a new life, in the name of Jesus. Lord, set my heart free from all fear and all doubt, in the name of Jesus.

title: Forgiveness
text: Hearts are opened and every offence released, so that nothing held against another person stands in the way of the deliverance about to be received. Father, I release from my heart every person who has offended me, wounded me or betrayed me, in the name of Jesus. Lord, I forgive those who opened doors of destruction over my life through what they did to me, in the name of Jesus. Father, take from me every root of bitterness, resentment and unforgiveness, in the name of Jesus. Lord, heal my heart where the offence is still sore, in the name of Jesus. Father, forgive me where I have held a grudge and called it strength, in the name of Jesus. Lord, I refuse to carry vengeance — vengeance belongs to God, and I hand every case over to You, in the name of Jesus. Father, deliver me from every evil tongue and from every desire to repay evil for evil, in the name of Jesus. Lord, let no unforgiveness in my heart block my deliverance tonight, in the name of Jesus. Father, give me a heart that forgives quickly and a mouth that blesses, in the name of Jesus.

title: Renunciation
text: Renunciation revokes consent. Pastor Kiky led the congregation to renounce the familiar spirit by name and by every disguise it wears. In the name of Jesus, I renounce every familiar spirit that masquerades as family members, friends, coworkers, neighbours and other familiar faces that I see on a regular basis. I renounce every familiar spirit that is in my spiritual house, in the name of Jesus. I renounce every evil spirit that came to me through mediums, diviners, witch doctors and false prophets, in the name of Jesus. I renounce every spirit guide, every monitoring spirit and every ancestral spirit assigned to direct my steps, in the name of Jesus. I renounce every familiar spirit burial and every familiar spirit connection, in the name of Jesus. I renounce every occult book, every ungodly literature and every defiled material I ever took into my mind, in the name of Jesus. I renounce every deposit given to me through food, through a word, or through hands laid on me, in the name of Jesus. I renounce every agreement I made knowingly or ignorantly with a familiar spirit, in the name of Jesus. Deliver my soul, Lord, from everything that makes me familiar to these spirits, in the name of Jesus. I renounce, I denounce and I will have no dealing with these spirits from this point on, in the name of Jesus.

title: Breaking Covenants
text: Every covenant, soul tie, spiritual marriage and initiation is dissolved by the power in the blood of Jesus. Every covenant between me and any familiar spirit, break by the power of the Holy Ghost, in the name of Jesus. I break every soul tie made with familiar spirits, knowingly and unknowingly, by the power in the blood of Jesus. Every strange covenant binding me to a familiar spirit — wherever I went, wherever my mother went, wherever my father went — be broken, in the name of Jesus. Every spiritual marriage with a familiar spirit, by the blood of Jesus, be destroyed. Cancel every initiation of familiar spirits against my destiny, in the name of Jesus. Every invisible ring placed on my finger, I remove you and I divorce that spirit, in the name of Jesus. Every ancestral curse over my life and over my destiny, be destroyed, in the name of Jesus. Every curse that found its way into my financial life, be destroyed, in the name of Jesus. Every spell and every enchantment spoken against my life by familiar spirits, be destroyed, in the name of Jesus. Every identification mark placed on me by a familiar spirit, I wipe it off with the blood of Jesus. You demon have no legal rights over my life and my destiny, through the blood of Jesus.

title: Breaking Altars
text: The altars, thrones, networks and habitations that sustain a familiar spirit are pulled down so that the spirit has nowhere to sit and nothing to speak from. Every altar used by familiar spirits against my life, I plead the blood of Jesus over you tonight, in the name of Jesus. Every seat of familiar spirits in my life, receive the fire of the Lord, in the name of Jesus. Every throne of familiar spirits, be dismantled right now, in the name of Jesus. Every stronghold of familiar spirits, be pulled down by the blood of Jesus. Let the habitation of familiar spirits in my body, in my home and at my workplace become desolate, in the name of Jesus. Every network of familiar spirits, be dismantled by the blood of Jesus. Every communication system of familiar spirits, be destroyed right now, in the name of Jesus. Every transportation system of familiar spirits, I burn you to ashes by the fire of God, in the name of Jesus. Every monitoring system, every monitoring bed and every monitoring device planted against me, be destroyed, in the name of Jesus. Every satanic sacrifice assigned to steal my laughter, be destroyed by the blood of Jesus. Every altar of sorrow raised against my marriage, my finances and my business, be destroyed, in the name of Jesus. Let the weapons of familiar spirits jam against them and turn back on their senders, in the name of Jesus.

title: Deliverance
text: The eviction itself: by the finger of God, by the blood of Jesus and by the fire of the Holy Ghost, every familiar spirit is commanded out. By the finger of God, I cast out every evil spirit from my soul and from my home, in the name of Jesus. Every plant which my heavenly Father has not planted in my life, be rooted up, in the name of Jesus. Every deposit of familiar spirits in my blood, my body, my eyes, my ears, my mouth, my stomach and my feet, come out by air or by liquid, through every opening of my body, in the name of Jesus. I silence, I destroy and I blind every familiar spirit — you will not see or hear me, in the name of Jesus. Every cage of familiar spirits holding my life, my destiny, my joy and my laughter, be destroyed by the blood of Jesus. Every remote control and device planted into my life and into my body, be destroyed by the blood of Jesus. Every connection controlling my thoughts, be disconnected by the blood of Jesus. Every familiar spirit from my mother's side and from my father's side, be disconnected from my life and my destiny, in the name of Jesus. Every chain, every padlock and every restricting device used against my life, be broken right now, in the name of Jesus. I resist the devil, and he must flee from me, in the name of Jesus. Holy Spirit, lay Your hand upon me and set me free, in the name of Jesus. Every familiar spirit hovering around my atmosphere, I command you out right now, in the name of Jesus.

title: Healing
text: What the spirit planted in the body is uprooted, and the Lord who went about healing all that were oppressed of the devil is asked to restore health of mind and body. Let the blood of Jesus run through my veins and cleanse me of every sickness and death planted inside me by familiar spirits, in the name of Jesus. Every strange sickness and every inherited disease propagated by familiar spirits, be destroyed, in the name of Jesus. Every affliction, every plague and every infirmity, loose me now, in the name of Jesus. Every mental torment caused by familiar spirits, be lifted, and let me receive a sound mind, in the name of Jesus. Lord, heal my heart where the wound of what was done to me is still open, in the name of Jesus. Every scale placed on my eyes, be removed — I will see properly, I will choose properly, I will think properly, in the name of Jesus. Father, resurrect my strength and heal every area of my life, in the name of Jesus. Let the Holy Spirit work in my body, my mind and my ears, and complete what He has begun, in the name of Jesus. Every sleeplessness and every night torment, be destroyed, and let me sleep in peace, in the name of Jesus.

title: Restoration
text: After the eviction comes the return of what was stolen — peace, favour, grace, finances, elevation, direction and rest. Father, restore every virtue that has come out of me, in the name of Jesus. I call out my peace today, I call out my favour today, I call out my grace today, in the name of Jesus. Let my blessings, my elevation, my grace and my favour that were withheld be released to me now, in the name of Jesus. I withdraw my life and my blessings from every strong room of familiar spirits, in the name of Jesus. Let my finances be released, and let my toiling be over, in the name of Jesus. Let every open door come into alignment, and let advancement come to my workplace, my marriage and my business, in the name of Jesus. Lord, loose upon me the spirit of grace, miracles, victory, excellence, wisdom and supernatural breakthrough, in the name of Jesus. I will not be lost, I will not get stuck, I will not be stranded — I will find my path again, in the name of Jesus. The Lord will order my steps and I will not run another person's race, in the name of Jesus. My destiny will not be aborted and my life will not be cut short, in the name of Jesus.

title: Thanksgiving
text: The service opened with gratitude from Psalm 121 and closed with thanksgiving for the deliverance received; the grateful heart keeps the door shut. Father, I thank You that I did not wake because an alarm rang — I woke because You breathed life into me, in the name of Jesus. I thank You, Lord, that my going out and my coming in are in Your hands, in the name of Jesus. I thank You that You do not slumber nor sleep, and that You watch over me at all times, in the name of Jesus. I thank You, Father, for the seen and unseen battles You have fought for me, in the name of Jesus. I thank You for the forgiveness of my sins and for the blood that washed me, in the name of Jesus. I thank You for revelation, because my people perish for lack of knowledge, in the name of Jesus. I thank You, Father, for my deliverance — whatever left me tonight, I thank You that it is gone, in the name of Jesus. I thank You for the Holy Ghost, for Your angels, for strength and for ability, in the name of Jesus. Not unto us, O Lord, but unto Your name be all glory, honour, power, dominion and majesty for evermore, in the name of Jesus.

title: Protection
text: Barricade the life with the blood of Jesus against any future attack, and ask for the covering that God Himself provided for the woman in Revelation 12. I barricade my life with the blood of Jesus against every future attack of the familiar spirit, in the name of Jesus. Father, mark me and my household as a passover to every entity poised to destroy and to confuse, in the name of Jesus. Let angels of deliverance encamp around my home, my car and my workplace, in the name of Jesus. Every monitoring eye and every evil eye watching my life through friendship, be blinded, in the name of Jesus. Let no false prophet see anything concerning me, in the name of Jesus. Every trap prepared for me, let the wicked fall into their own nets, in the name of Jesus. Lord, hide me in the path which no fowl knoweth and which the vulture's eye hath not seen, in the name of Jesus. Father, prepare my place and nourish me there, as You did for the woman in Revelation 12, in the name of Jesus. Cover my children, my marriage, my finances and my ministry with the blood of Jesus. The Lord shall preserve me from all evil; He shall preserve my soul, my going out and my coming in, in the name of Jesus.

title: Sealing
text: Nothing is left open. Every deliverance is sealed with the blood of Jesus, every emptied place is filled with the Holy Spirit, and every door is shut. By the blood of Jesus, I seal and shut every door, every portal and every entry that familiar spirits were using to gain access to me, in the name of Jesus. I seal my deliverance with the blood of Jesus — whatever has left me will never return, in the name of Jesus. Holy Spirit, fill every place that has been vacated in me, in the name of Jesus. Let every door the enemy opened in my life be shut one by one, until the Lord gives me my rest, in the name of Jesus. Father, strengthen me with might by Your Spirit in the inner man, and let Christ dwell in my heart by faith, in the name of Jesus. I am a new creature — old things are passed away, and I will not pick them up again, in the name of Jesus. Renew my mind, O Lord, so that the old pattern finds no place in me, in the name of Jesus. Let the peace of God guard my mind, my home and my sleep tonight, in the name of Jesus. Whom the Son sets free is free indeed — I am free and I remain free, in the name of Jesus.

title: Set One — Renouncing and Drinking the Blood
text: In the name of Jesus. I renounce every familiar spirit that masquerades as family members and the ones that are alive, friends, coworkers, neighbours, and other familiar faces that I see on a regular basis. I renounce every familiar spirit that is in my spiritual house. I declare that whenever these spirits try to approach me in my dream, by the blood of Jesus, I shut them down immediately. And they are destroyed by the blood of Jesus and by the power of the Holy Ghost. Lord, wash me clean with Your blood from the crown of my head to the soles of my feet. And cleanse me from every unclean deposit and evil food that I have eaten from the hands of the devil in my dreams and in my waking life. I decree and I declare that the fire of God, as I drink the blood of Jesus, runs through my veins and every chip of my vessel, and cleanses me of all sicknesses and death that may have been planted inside of me by familiar spirits. Jesus said, every plant that my heavenly Father has not planted will be uprooted by the roots. I stand on Matthew chapter fifteen verse thirteen. Lord, Your word is always relevant and never changes. I break every soul tie made with familiar spirits, knowingly and unknowingly, by the power in the blood of Jesus. I decree and I declare that I cast every monitoring spirit into their dry places, and through the Holy Spirit that lives inside of me, I demand that they do not return. By the power in the blood of Jesus, as I drink the blood of Jesus, I silence and I destroy. I blind every familiar spirit. You will not see or hear me in the name of Jesus. You demon have no legal rights, through the blood of Jesus, over my life and destiny. I pour out by the blood of Jesus the wrath of God upon you. Jesus became a curse for me to set me free. So I declare that I stand on that freedom, and I refuse to allow any demon, any familiar spirit, to take my blessings, my elevation, my grace, my favour away from me. As I drink the blood of Jesus, Father, deliver me from every familiar spirit and my strong enemies. Father, set me free! By the power of the Holy Ghost, as I drink the blood of Jesus, cancel every initiation of familiar spirits against my destiny. Every spiritual marriage with familiar spirits, by the blood of Jesus, be destroyed. I reverse every evil pattern of familiar spirits in my destiny. By the power of the Holy Ghost, every cage of familiar spirits held in my life and my destiny, held in my joy and my laughter, by the blood of Jesus, I command you to be destroyed. Spirits in my blood, in my body, in my eyes, in my ears, in my mouth, in my stomach, in my feet, in my body system — as I drink the blood, I command you to come out. By air or liquid, every opening in my body, in the name of Jesus.

title: Set Two — Sealing and Shutting Every Door
text: In the name of Jesus. Father, in the name of Jesus, by the blood of Jesus, I seal and shut every door, every portal, and every entry the familiar spirits are using to gain access to me. By the blood of Jesus, I destroy them right now. I smash all monitoring communication devices, and I destroy them into pieces. By the blood of Jesus, I burn them to ashes. By the fire of God, I dethrone every familiar spirit, and I declare that they receive the fire of God tonight. Father, destroy their deposits inside my body by the blood of Jesus. By the blood, by the fire of God, I destroy into pieces and I burn into ashes every transportation system used by familiar spirits. I plead the blood of Jesus over every altar used by familiar spirits tonight. Deliver me, Father. Separate me from every power of familiar spirits in the mighty name of Jesus. I declare that every remote control and device that they have planted into my life and into my body, by the blood of Jesus that I have taken, let it be destroyed right now. I declare in the mighty name of Jesus, their plans, their attempts, their assignments and their efforts against my destiny are frustrated right now. I speak death to their habitation — their habitation in my body, their habitation in my home, their habitation at my workplace. Let it become desolate right now by the blood of Jesus. I command every familiar spirit hovering around my atmosphere, I command you out — out right now in the mighty name of Jesus. I command every familiar spirit deposit in my body, I command you out right now in the mighty name of Jesus. I will cough you out. I will vomit you out. I will gag you out. Get out by air or liquid, in the mighty name of Jesus. Every trap that they prepared for me, fall into themselves right now. Let the wicked fall into their nets right now by the power of the Holy Ghost. I declare that they fight among themselves right now, and they destroy each other right now, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.

title: Set Three — Every Chain and Every Padlock
text: Every chain! Every chain! Every chain! Every padlock! Every other restricting device that they have used against my life, I command it to be broken right now in the name of Jesus. I walk out free with angelic assistance right now, and no one can stop me. Just like when Peter was delivered from the prison by an angel, and no one knew how that happened so miraculously. I am coming out. I am coming out. By air or liquid, by every opening in my body, I will cough you out, I will burp you out, I will vomit you out now in the name of Jesus.

title: Set Four — Divorcing the Spiritual Marriage
text: You familiar spirit, I divorce you now in the mighty name of Jesus. I divorce you now. As I anoint my hands with this oil, I divorce you. I divorce you. Go now in the name of Jesus.

title: Set Five — I Am Free
text: I am free. I am free. I am free. Father, I am free from this spirit in the name of Jesus. I receive it in the name of Jesus. Break — break, break, break in the name of Jesus. Break by the power of the Holy Ghost.

title: Set Six — After the Deliverance
text: Father, by the power of the Holy Ghost and in the mighty name of Jesus, everything that I ask of You will be done unto me. Whatever these demons were stopping me from doing, it will come to pass. My faith, my glory, everything in my life, O Lord — every blessing will come in alignment in the mighty name of Jesus. Every open door will come in alignment. Let the blessings of the Lord rest upon me, Father, in the name of Jesus. I call out my peace today. I call out my favour today. I call out my grace today. I will not fail in my life, O Father. You will move me forward in the name of Jesus. My destiny will not be aborted. My life will not be cut short. I will not be destroyed in any way. Blessings will come to me, elevation will come to me, my peace will come to me. I will celebrate in the mighty name of Jesus. I will find my path again. I will find my path again.

title: Set Seven — The Prayer of Salvation
text: Dear Lord Jesus. Thank you for dying on the cross for my sin. Please forgive me. Come into my life. I receive you as my Lord and Saviour. Now help me to live for you. For the rest of my life. In Jesus' name I pray, Amen.

title: God Forbids Divination and Familiar Spirits
text: Deuteronomy 18:9-12 When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations. There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch. Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer. For all that do these things are an abomination unto the LORD: and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee. Leviticus 19:31 Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God. Leviticus 20:27 A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them. Isaiah 8:19 And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead? Isaiah 29:4 And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust. 2 Chronicles 33:6 And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

title: The Dead Know Nothing
text: Ecclesiastes 9:5 For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten. Hebrews 9:27 And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment: 1 Samuel 28:7 Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.

title: The Holy Spirit
text: John 14:26 But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you. Acts 2:38 Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost. 1 Corinthians 2:12 Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of God; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God. 1 John 4:4 Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world. John 14:6 Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

title: Thanksgiving and the Keeper of Israel
text: Psalm 121:1-8 I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth. He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber. Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand. The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night. The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul. The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore. Psalm 94:1 O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

title: Repentance and Cleansing
text: 1 John 1:8-10 If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us. If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us. Acts 2:38 Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

title: Authority and Victory
text: James 4:7 Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you. Matthew 15:13 But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up. 2 Samuel 22:18 He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me. Psalm 144:1-2 Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me. Ezekiel 25:17 And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them. Acts 12:7-11 And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands. And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me. And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision. When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him. And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the LORD hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

title: The Blood of Jesus
text: 1 John 5:7-8 For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one. And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one. Revelation 12:11 And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.

title: Identity in Christ
text: 2 Corinthians 5:17 Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new. 1 Peter 2:9 But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light: Romans 8:15 For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father. John 8:36 If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed. Ephesians 3:16-19 That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man; That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love, May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height; And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

title: Protection
text: Psalm 121:7-8 The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul. The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore. Job 28:7 There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture’s eye hath not seen: Revelation 12:13-17 And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child. And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent. And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood. And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth. And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.

title: Healing and God Reveals to Redeem
text: 2 Kings 20:1-6 In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live. Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD, saying, I beseech thee, O LORD, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore. And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying, Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD. And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake. 1 Samuel 16:23 And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him. John 10:10 The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

title: Knowledge and Discernment
text: Hosea 4:6 My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children. Romans 12:2 And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

title: Salvation
text: Romans 10:9 That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved. John 14:6 Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me. John 8:36 If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

title: David — the harp that silenced a distressing spirit
text: When a distressing spirit came upon King Saul, David was sent for to play the harp and to sing the words of the Psalms over him. Scripture records that Saul was refreshed and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him. David did not argue with the spirit; he filled the atmosphere with the word of God set to worship. The same David later wrote that the Lord teaches his hands to war and his fingers to fight, and that God delivered him from his strong enemy. Words are spirit and they are alive. When a believer speaks the Psalms aloud in the atmosphere, distressing spirits are silenced and pushed back. Worship and the spoken word are not decoration around deliverance — in David's case they were the deliverance. 1 Samuel 16:23 Psalm 144:1-2 2 Samuel 22:18

title: King Saul and the woman with a familiar spirit at Endor
text: Saul had lost the voice of God, and instead of repenting he sought a woman who had a familiar spirit at Endor and asked her to bring up Samuel. Saul had himself put the mediums out of the land, and yet in his fear he went to one by night in disguise. What proceeded from that consultation was not comfort but a sentence of death, and Saul died the next day. Scripture is blunt about the cause: he enquired of one that had a familiar spirit rather than enquiring of the Lord. Desperation is the doorway a familiar spirit waits for. When God seems silent, the remedy is repentance and the Holy Spirit, never a medium. The living have no business seeking to the dead, and every consultation costs more than it ever gives. 1 Samuel 28:7 Leviticus 19:31 Ecclesiastes 9:5

title: Manasseh — the king who dealt with a familiar spirit
text: Manasseh caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom, observed times, used enchantments and witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit and with wizards. Scripture summarises it in one sentence: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger. His personal traffic with these spirits became a national defilement that took generations to undo. Pastor Kiky read this verse in the middle of the deliverance as the Lord's furious rebuke against every such enemy. What one person opens, a household and a nation can inherit. Dealing with a familiar spirit is never private, and it provokes God's anger precisely because it destroys the people He loves. 2 Chronicles 33:6

title: Hezekiah — the king who turned his face to the wall
text: Hezekiah was sick unto death, and the prophet Isaiah brought him a word to set his house in order because he would die and not live. Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed, reminding God how he had walked before Him in truth and with a perfect heart, and he wept sore. Before Isaiah had left the middle court, the word of the LORD came again: the prayer was heard, the tears were seen, and fifteen years were added to his life. God reveals in order to redeem. A familiar spirit reveals a hard thing so that it will happen; God reveals it so that you will pray and it will not. As soon as you turn your face to the wall, God terminates the appointments of the wicked over your life. 2 Kings 20:1-6

title: Peter — freed from the prison by an angel
text: Peter was held in prison, bound with two chains, sleeping between two soldiers, with keepers before the door. The church prayed without ceasing. An angel of the Lord came, a light shined in the prison, the chains fell off his hands, and Peter walked out past guard after guard until the iron gate opened of its own accord. He himself did not know at first that it was real, so completely was it the work of God and not of man. This is the pattern the congregation declared over their own deliverance: I walk out free with angelic assistance right now, and no one can stop me. Chains, padlocks and restricting devices are not obstacles to God — and the prayers of the church are what the angel was answering. Acts 12:7-11

title: The woman of Revelation 12
text: A woman clothed with the sun travailed to bring forth a man child, and a great red dragon stood before her to devour the child as soon as it was born. The child was caught up unto God, and the woman fled into a wilderness place prepared of God, where she was nourished. The dragon, cast down to the earth, persecuted the woman and cast a flood out of his mouth after her, but the earth helped the woman and swallowed the flood. The dragon then went to make war with the remnant of her seed. The dragon did not chase the woman for what she was but for what she carried — she carried a Saviour. The intensity of an attack is a measure of an assignment, not of weakness. And in the same chapter where the pursuit is recorded, so is the provision: God prepared her place, God nourished her there, and the earth itself helped her. Revelation 12:1-6 Revelation 12:13-17

title: The Israelites warned in Deuteronomy 18
text: As Israel came into the land God had given them, they were commanded not to learn to do after the abominations of those nations. Nine practices were named — passing a son or daughter through the fire, divination, observing times, enchanting, witchcraft, charming, consulting with familiar spirits, wizardry and necromancy. All of them were called an abomination unto the LORD, and it was because of these very abominations that God drove those nations out before Israel. The same chapter goes on to promise a Prophet whom God would raise up, in whose mouth He would put His words. God never forbade a lawful voice without providing one. Israel was told to refuse the diviner because God Himself would speak to them; the church has the Comforter who teaches all things. Every consultation with a familiar spirit is therefore a rejection of a provision God has already made. Deuteronomy 18:9-12
